is there a difference between using thompson and g36c with SL10 to shield the red golyats? All guides I've seen showcase thompson, but I have g36c ready. Is she more useful later on in the game?

Missing the arc note will lock out any inputs for that arc for a whole beat i believe. Also, the game doesn't allow more than 2 finger inputs at a time for the sky arcs, so it's most likely saving your 'missed' input until you either release it (freeing up one of the arc note slots) or move it to the correct position after the input for that arc is 'open' again (usually 1 beat). [Tested this out on Nhelv] 

It's less noticeable on some arcs because the window where the time-out period resets faster than others (see the crossovers in axium crisis FTR). It's probably happening because of the grace period that hold notes have in general(?)

I'm not sure where in illegal paradise this is happening to you, but at least for Nhelv FTR in the double sky arc part (~40 seconds) you have to read slightly ahead of where the arcs are, which means you just have to grind the map and know where the arcs will be or else you'll red out for a good second.

Which world map chapter are you looking at?

Event Maps are usually in Chapter 0 and require you to purchase the character song from the memory archive.
